limitations: Public hb_ot_metrics_get_position is used without its synthesizing fallback variant. Missing values are explicit null, distinct from true zero; unavailable or sanitized-away tables are not separately diagnosed by this interface.

This fixed profile chooses OS/2 typo metrics when USE_TYPO_METRICS is set, otherwise hhea, applies the pinned library MVAR interpretation and normalizes ascender/descender signs. It is not a raw table dump or an accepted Office/WPS metric policy.

The independent upstream executable avoids our ABI, allocator and shared font helper but uses the same HarfBuzz algorithm. Its 286 instances include 256 identical stress-batch inputs, not 286 distinct fonts.

Separate FontTools calculations cover ten owned two-axis instances and all 28 metrics, with exact binary-representable region weights and zero tolerance. This is not exhaustive variation-table coverage.
Fault positions cover fixed shaping and measurement fixtures only. ASan/UBSan success is not complete font fuzzing, TSan or a proof of all allocation paths.
Identity, directory, metadata and cmap checks do not amount to complete font sanitization; glyph/layout/variation programs remain subject to additional validation and compatibility work.

Measurements remain integer design64 units. Font-size scaling, target metric selection, baseline alignment, line fitting, contextual line reshaping, vertical layout, justification and drawing remain incomplete.
Current batch transport uploads a font once but creates component font objects per instance. No new performance or full-resource-budget claim is made.
Production process pools, OS sandbox profiles, browser Worker deployment, hard cancellation and all platform builds remain incomplete.
Editable advanced presentation objects, rendering/playback, Office/WPS acceptance and Musterwork replacement gates E0-E3 remain incomplete.
